147:t_1:87.en:
???
「I have no intention of introducing myself. I only came to see your face before I get to work.」

147:t_1:88.en:
$n
「I don't intend to waste time talking...!」

147:t_1:92.en:
???
「That was... an unusual power... It seems different from a $$スフィア・アクト$$.」

147:t_1:93.en:
$n
「You... What did you do to me...?!」

147:t_1:94.en:
???
「I'd expect no less from the 《$$いがみ合う双子$$》. Even under my $$スフィア・アクト$$, you're desperately trying to reject it in your heart.」

147:t_1:95.en:
???
「How foolish... You're clinging to faint memories within you, trying to reject hatred.」

147:t_1:97.en:
???
「This meeting is just a bit of fun. Once my work is done, I'll play with you.」

147:t_1:98.en:
???
「Struggle all you like until then, $$リアクター$$ of the $$いがみ合う双子$$.」

147:t_1:103.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I had a bad feeling, so I came into town... What on earth happened...?!」

147:t_1:106.en:
$n
「Yes... He's... the source of... the unease we felt...」

147:t_1:107.en:
$n
「He's a $$サイデリアル$$ $$スフィア・リアクター$$.」

147:t_1:113.en:
$$市民$$
「$$ゼロ$$, leader of the $$黒の騎士団$$!」

147:t_1:114.en:
$$市民$$
「This country was dragged into war because of you!」

147:t_1:116.en:
$$黒の騎士団$$
「Shut up! We'd have been fine living under the $$ブリタニア・ユニオン$$ as long as we could live in peace!」

147:t_1:117.en:
$$市民$$
「But you trampled on that! We'll never forgive you!」

147:t_1:121.en:
$$スザク$$
「Stop! What will lashing out with hatred here accomplish?!」

147:t_1:122.en:
$$市民$$
「Are you trying to get in our way?!」

147:t_1:126.en:
$$藤堂$$
「We have no choice! We'll subdue them!」

147:t_1:127.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Don't use guns! We are only to incapacitate them!」

147:t_1:131.en:
$$玉城$$
「What the hell are these guys?! Zombies or something?!」

147:t_1:137.en:
$$扇$$
「You're going to save $$新日本$$, aren't you?! I won't let you die here!!」

147:t_1:138.en:
$$扇$$
「I... This time, I'll trust you to the very end! So!!」

147:t_1:158.en:
$$スザク$$
「We don't know either... Those people suddenly came here and started denouncing $$ゼロ$$...」

147:t_1:159.en:
$$玉城$$
「It makes no damn sense! They lashed out at us with hatred and completely crazy reasoning!」

147:t_1:160.en:
$$藤堂$$
「To stop them, $$ゼロ$$ had no choice but to...」

147:t_1:163.en:
$$スザク$$
「He had no choice... The only other way to stop them was to take their lives...」

147:t_1:166.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The look in my attackers' eyes... It was the same as when 《$$ガドライト#keyword$$》 $$メオンサム$$ amplified the conflicting emotions in people's hearts.」

147:t_1:169.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「This is speculation, but someone probably amplified the part of them that couldn't forgive me... their hatred.」

147:t_1:170.en:
$$扇$$
「I never imagined anyone could do that...」

147:t_1:171.en:
$$藤堂$$
「Is it the power of $$ギアス$$?」

147:t_1:172.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「No... Now that the $$ギアス嚮団$$ is gone, no new users can emerge.」

147:t_1:173.en:
$$玉城$$
「Then what the hell is it?!」

147:t_1:175.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「The problem is that someone with that power is here in $$新日本$$ with malicious intent.」

147:t_1:176.en:
$$扇$$
「A power that amplifies hatred...! If someone used that in $$新日本$$ as it is now...!」

147:t_1:177.en:
$$スザク$$
「People's hearts would grow even more bitter, and fighting the Empire would become the least of our concerns.」
